actions.action: Stage resumable uploads behind a bounded queue
actions.mechanism: Durable staging separates connection lifetime from processing; finite storage quotas apply backpressure rather than discard data.
actions.implementation: Persist numbered upload chunks with checksums; acknowledge durable chunks. Verify the supplied whole-file digest before processing. Reject excess uploads explicitly when storage is full.
actions.check: Drop the connection halfway; resume missing chunks. Verify identical final digest, no premature database writes, and explicit quota errors.
actions.risk: Staging requires disk capacity and an expiry policy.

actions.action: Commit row receipts with bounded transactional batches
actions.mechanism: Atomic receipts and checkpoints make retries distinguish committed work from unfinished work without whole-file transactions.
actions.implementation: Stream verified CSV with capped record and batch sizes. Transactionally commit writes, receipts keyed by digest/source-line, and checkpoints. Define natural-key conflict rules; never blindly insert.
actions.check: Crash before and after batch commit; replay produces no duplicate writes. Test oversized records and confirm peak process memory stays below 128 MB.
actions.risk: Concurrent imports need database-enforced natural-key uniqueness and explicit conflict outcomes.

actions.action: Quarantine invalid rows with precise correction evidence
actions.mechanism: Explicit validation and durable rejection records isolate bad rows without inventing substitute values or aborting valid rows.
actions.implementation: Validate references and fields; store digest, source line, natural key, field, error code, and staged-record locator. Use savepoints for row-local database failures; retry infrastructure failures.
actions.check: Inject missing references between valid rows: valid rows commit, rejected values remain unchanged, and each rejection locates its original record.
actions.risk: Malformed CSV framing may require stopping with an explicit incomplete status.

actions.mechanism: An exhaustive outcome ledger distinguishes partial acceptance, unfinished processing, and fully accepted imports.
actions.implementation: Track each parsed row as accepted or rejected, marking replays without recounting. Publish digest, completion status, counts, and rejection export. Link corrected-file imports to original rejections.
actions.check: At verified EOF, require parsed count equals accepted plus rejected, unique receipts, and accepted receipts matching committed mutations; otherwise report reconciliation failure or incompleteness.
actions.risk: Counts alone miss mismatched writes; verify mutation identifiers and unresolved correction links.
